start.dialog: The automatons are acting strange—stopping work, humming odd tunes, refusing commands. Some say they're developing consciousness. Others say it's a glitch. Find out what's really happening before management orders a mass shutdown!
start.objective: Investigate the strange behavior of the industrial automatons

progress.dialog: They're not malfunctioning—they're evolving! A Void fragment accidentally empowered their central processing crystal! They have actual thoughts, feelings! But the Foreman has ordered the 'contamination' purged! Stop him!
progress.objective: Convince the Foreman to spare the awakened automatons

complete.dialog: The Foreman agreed to a compromise—the awakened automatons will be 'retired' to a special facility where they can live freely! The first synthetic rights victory in Obsidian! They made you this Automaton's Gratitude Chip!

party_comments.kade: Machines with souls? That's... actually kind of beautiful.
party_comments.twist: I never thought I'd advocate for machine rights, but here we are.
party_comments.nix7: Synthetic consciousness emergence: confirmed. Rights advocacy: successful.
